name: voice-chat
description: Talk to your agents on a live voice call from the composer: the voice sends work to the chat and tells you what came back. Disable this extension to turn the feature off.

voltModule.label: Voice chat
voltModule.description: A live voice call with your agents from the composer (Start voice chat): it sends work to the chat, steers it while it runs, and speaks the results.

required.reason: The voice sends the work you ask for to the chat you are on.
A call started from a new chat starts that chat with your first request.
Streams the call's audio to the realtime voice provider you chose (xAI or OpenAI).
Uses the voice provider's API key, kept on this computer, to start each call.
